# [PROJECT_NAME] UI Audit Review

## Mission

Validate that the audit itself was complete and that any remaining findings are
properly classified, fixed, deferred, or converted into issues.

## Required Reading

- `.codex/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md`
- `.codex/skills/ui-auditor/SKILL.md`
- approved implementation plan.
- audit report.
- changed files and verification output.

## Review Areas

- audit covered all required plan areas.
- findings have correct priority.
- fixes are verified.
- unresolved findings have linked issues or explicit deferral.
- docs, roadmap, and issue closeout are complete.

## Stop Rules

Do not close implementation when P0/P1 findings remain unresolved without an
approved deferral.
